Needs changes before merge. The code checks pass. The PR body needs one required explanation.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. I read the whole diff and checked the laws in upstream/main's current AGENTS.md.

The change reuses the finished-part sweep and reports `RapidInPart` at the crossing move. The scoped stamp makes old milling Envelope caches stale. The tests preserve the clear exit and peck cases.

**Results merged with main**

All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-4108`. No GitHub runner was used.

- PR head: `b12047dab3b367bfcbbff34fd636ec462c36f94c`.
- Main: `79ca6a088ac80ce4627c88db8668513a3dc5703a`.
- Trial merge: `8f26e1db7e9a8ace4063ac692dfb63fbb893dcc7`. Its first parent is the PR head. The merge is clean.
- Quick gate: 74/74 steps passed; 1,119 tests passed, zero failed, four ignored.
- Pinning suite `vertical_rapid_part`: 6/6 passed.
- `posed_contact`: 5/5 passed.
- `example_catalog`: 44 passed, zero failed, four release-only tests ignored. The saved-cache regression passed.
- Light lane: all six steps passed, including its build; all 11 tests passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The inherited sccache stalled before the first build completed. I stopped that attempt and ran all checks with the wrapper disabled.

**Extra suites run**

- `camcraft-app --test example_catalog_adaptive`: 1/1 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test example_catalog_edge_work`: 1/1 passed.
- The quick gate also ran `camcraft-app --test solid_law_goldens`: 7/7 passed.

No fixture or importer changed. No recorded program or golden moved. Full heavy lanes were not required for this P3 issue.

**Mutations**

1. Omit the new sweep call: all four canopy assertions failed. The clear exit and peck controls passed. Restore the call: 6/6 passed.
2. Omit the new cache salt: the saved-cache regression failed with `left: Ok`, `right: Stale`. Restore the salt: 1/1 passed.

Both mutations were temporary. The worktree is clean. No code, evidence, or images were committed or pushed.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/sim/tests/vertical_rapid_part.rs:1` — Class: missing explanation for a new test binary. The current AGENTS.md rule **New tests join a directory suite** requires a one-line reason in the PR body for each new top-level integration binary. Add that reason for this binary. Alternatively, put these tests in an existing domain directory suite. This is the only blocker; a body explanation can close it without a code change.

**Notes**

A generated canopy collision through a tilted setup was not exercised, as the PR body states. The warm worktree and branch remain in place. The author's ready flag is unchanged.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Hi @dylanoliverdo-coder. This one is very close. The code checks and the mutation tests all passed, and the only open item from the last review is the one explanation it asks for in the PR body (see "Requested before merge" in that review). Add it to the body; no new push is needed. A collaborator re-review of the same head then clears it. Tell us if you'd like us to draft the text.

Thanks. The body now gives the one-line reason that the **New tests join a directory suite** rule asks for: `crates/sim/tests/vertical_rapid_part.rs` is top-level because camcraft-sim has no directory suite it fits (its only one is `model_excess`). There is no code change and no new push; the head is still `b12047dab`. It is ready for the collaborator re-review of the same head.
